// diagnostic

E0433

The result of `{call}` is thrown away

What

The result of `{call}` is thrown away

Why

A pure call (no effects, nothing passed with `&`) does nothing when its result is dropped; a function with no return type loses the value of its last line

Fix

For a pure call, use the result or bind it with `result :: {call}`; for a last line, write `-> T` after the parameter list if the function should return it; write `.drop("reason")` to discard on purpose

Worked example

First UI snapshot mentioning E0433: tests/ui/discarded_lost_tail.stderr.

Error [E0433]: This Int value is thrown away
  --> discarded_lost_tail.jet:5:5
    |
  5 |     a + b
    |     ^^^^^
 Why: `total` has no return type, so it returns nothing and the value of its last line is lost
 Fix: If `total` should return it, write `-> Int` after its parameter list; to discard it on purpose, write `.drop("reason")`
